So far I have: The sequence formula \(a_n=n\cos(n\pi/2)\) and the target sum \(S_{2013}=\sum_{n=1}^{2013} a_n\) are correctly stated.
However, My first classification of \(\cos(n\pi/2)\) says it is \(0\) if \(n\) is even; that is false. The cosine is zero for odd \(n\), while for even \(n=2k\) it equals \(\cos(k\pi)=(-1)^k\), so it is \(-1\) when \(n\equiv2\pmod4\) and \(1\) when \(n\equiv0\pmod4\).
Next, Use the correct period-4 pattern: odd terms vanish, and the even terms are \(a_{2k}=2k(-1)^k\); then sum \(k=1,\ldots,1006\).
</reflection>
